scope: Proposition 10.2 (Momentum characteristic integrals) of the manuscript “Quantum Depletion and Momentum Distribution in the Dilute Hard-Sphere Bose Gas” (preprints/Quantum-Depletion-and-Momentum-Distribution-in-the-Dilute-Hard-Sphere-Bose-Gas-October-5-2026/Quantum-Depletion-in-the-Dilute-Hard-Sphere-Bose-Gas.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 267 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9e8a9907a3ac0811), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 75. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every fixed H < ∞, Z eih·p dmΦ(p) = Z R3 eih·p Fα(p) dp (2π)3 + o(1), |h| ≤ H. (10.8) The error is uniform in h and in normalized, possibly complex, ground vectors, with the iterated-limit convention of Section 2.
